'''Otheros''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. A proud owner of the [[Haven's Blaze]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he used the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|gangsters]] from the rival [[Lucky Runner]] casino.<ref name="BC1" /><ref name="BC2" /><ref name="WK" />
